create.name: Libby Barnett
create.bio:
Libby Barnett is a Reiki Master teacher in the traditional Usui system who has been practising since 1979. She first learned from John Harvey Gray, one of the twenty-two masters trained by Hawayo Takata, and was later initiated as a Reiki Master in 1989 through Judy-Carol Stewart, another line back to Takata. Before Reiki became her main work she trained as a social worker at Simmons and worked at Massachusetts General Hospital, and she says that counselling background still shapes the way she teaches. In 1999 she travelled to Kyoto and climbed Mount Kurama to learn more about Mikao Usui and the roots of the practice.

Her teaching is arranged as a ladder of certification classes, each a single day: Reiki I for self-practice and practice on others, Reiki II with its three symbols and distant work, and then three master levels for those who want to attune and train students of their own. Most classes now run live on Zoom, with in-person weekends in Asheville, North Carolina, and residential programmes at Kripalu. She has taught many thousands of students over four decades, including staff at New England hospitals, and co-wrote a widely read book on bringing Reiki into home, hospital and hospice care.

courses.title: Reiki I Certification Class
courses.description: A one-day first-degree class covering the history of Reiki, how the hands-on practice works and how to give it to yourself and others. Students receive the Reiki I attunement, a notebook and a certificate. Held online or in person.

courses.title: Reiki II Certification Class
courses.description: The second-degree class introduces the three traditional Reiki II symbols and how to use them, including sending Reiki at a distance. There is plenty of supervised hands-on practice, and students leave with the second-degree attunement and certificate.

courses.title: Reiki Master Class
courses.description: A one-day online class open to Reiki II graduates from any teacher. Students receive the master attunement and symbol, learn to give the Reiki I attunement and are given further tools for personal and spiritual growth.

courses.title: Reiki Master Teacher Class
courses.description: A one-day class that prepares Reiki Masters to teach Reiki I and II themselves, including the Reiki II attunement. It comes with teaching notebooks, a teacher's manual and practical advice on building a practice.

courses.title: Reiki Master of Masters Class
courses.description: A half-day class, the last level in her sequence, in which students learn to give the master attunement and run master trainings of their own. It ends with a personal ceremony and can also be booked privately.
